text:
sam: hey, running through the terraform quickstart (provider v0.3) to auto-create an org+workspace then run the node SDK example. workspace shows in console, card added, but first SDK call returns 402. any ideas?
ela: did the console show any billing warnings on the org page? sometimes there is a pending step after card entry.
sam: console says workspace active and payment method attached. API reply: 
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{
  "error": "billing_contact_unconfirmed",
  "message": "Billing contact needs to be confirmed before API access is enabled. See Console > Billing."
}
```
infra-bot: Note: org created by terraform provider (auto-provision) flagged as REQUIRES_CONTACT_CONFIRM.
devex: ah yes, we changed infra policy last sprint: to avoid accidental charges for infra-created orgs we require an explicit billing contact confirmation. looks like the quickstart example didn't include the extra step.
sam: is there an API I can call in CI to confirm? manual click won't work for automated tests.
devex: yes, there's a confirmation endpoint intended for infra flows. sample curl (requires org admin token):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.inference/api/v1/orgs/<ORG_ID>/billing/confirm-contact" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"contact_name":"Infra Bot","contact_email":"infra+ci@example.com","accepted_terms":true}'
```
ela: can the terraform provider call that automatically as a post-create hook? would be nice if example shows a local-exec step.
devex: good call. short term: add a snippet in the terraform quickstart showing a `null_resource` with `local-exec` to POST to confirm-contact. long term: we'll add a provider flag `auto_confirm_billing_contact = true` but that will be limited to sandbox/testing orgs. filing a task.
billing-bot: Billing status for org <ORG_ID>: PENDING_CONTACT_CONFIRMATION. No invoices generated. To enable API access: confirm billing contact via Console or API. For automation requests beyond sandbox, please open billing-team@redwood.com.
sam: thanks, the local-exec workaround fixed it and SDK call now 200. I'll open a PR to update the quickstart repo with the post-create step and a note in the README.
devex: can you also add a short note in the SDK error docs to suggest `billing_contact_unconfirmed` and point to the confirm endpoint? we could also improve the SDK to surface a link in the error to Console > Billing.
ela: +1 on making the error clearer in the SDK. surprised customers hit this unexpectedly.
sam: PR linked in a minute. leaving this thread as the record of the workaround.
devex: assigning followups: (1) quickstart example PR from sam, (2) provider issue to add `auto_confirm_billing_contact` for test orgs, (3) SDK error message improvement. closing once PR merges. :+1:
